items.q: What does Arnold actually want in a successor?
items.a: **[[sound-as-civil-service-virtue|Sound]].** Firm with ministers, tactful, suave. Not a reform KPI. Humphrey passes by asking *what will you do when you retire?*
Chair of Freedom of Information. Official: 'freedom not abused.' Subtext: leak the files if Humphrey forgets the deal. That is [[information-control-as-power]].

items.q: Why dump MI5 folders on Hacker?
items.a: Eric: 'horizontal jogging.' Duncan: offshore paper. Humphrey: sitting on it would be **very courageous**. Killer instinct is the last PM exam. Hacker fires the arrow.
Empty the field. No vote. Party looks united. 木鱼's rhyme: **Theresa May, 2016**. Palace: free to kiss hands at five?

items.q: Was the sausage still a problem when Hacker went on TV?
items.a: No. Maurice already agreed to call it the **British sausage**. Solved problems are not news.
Leak a fake EC ban today. Luther speech tomorrow. 'Up while I'm here.' File win becomes a public win.
Civil service runs the country. Party picks the face. Crown stamps it. Cabinet Secretary: one name, already picked at dinner.
Staffed hospital, no patients. No villain required. Comedy is how you swallow the report. Spectator, fatalist, or join like Hacker.
